# Log in pages: Centered card

The same content inside a bordered card on the gray page background (the card and muted options of the auth layout).

A complete standalone component built only from `@mod-internal/ui`, Angular and plain CSS with the library tokens. Copy it, rename the selector and class, replace the sample text and data with the project's own (and its translation mechanism), and keep the structure.

```ts
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FormControl, FormGroup, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import {
  ModAuthActions, ModAuthFooter, ModAuthHeader, ModAuthLayout,
  ModButton, ModCheckbox, ModIcon, ModInlineAlert, ModLink, ModTextInput,
} from '@mod-internal/ui';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-sign-in',
  imports: [
    ReactiveFormsModule, ModAuthActions, ModAuthFooter, ModAuthHeader, ModAuthLayout,
    ModButton, ModCheckbox, ModIcon, ModInlineAlert, ModLink, ModTextInput,
  ],
  template: `
    <mod-auth-layout variant="centered" card muted>
      <button modAuthActions mod-button variant="secondary-outline" size="medium" type="button" (click)="toggleLanguage()">
        <mod-icon name="language-square" /> عربي
      </button>

      <img class="sign-in__emblem" src="assets/img/emblem-placeholder.svg" width="64" height="66" alt="Organization name" />
      <mod-auth-header
        heading="Sign in"
        description="Enter your user name and password to access the system"
      />

      <form class="sign-in" [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="submit()" novalidate>
        @if (failed()) {
          <mod-inline-alert variant="error" colored heading="The user name or password is incorrect." />
        }

        <mod-text-input
          label="User name"
          formControlName="userName"
          autocomplete="username"
          required
          [error]="invalid('userName')"
          [helperText]="invalid('userName') ? 'This field is required' : ''"
        />
        <mod-text-input
          label="Password"
          type="password"
          formControlName="password"
          autocomplete="current-password"
          passwordToggle
          required
          [error]="invalid('password')"
          [helperText]="invalid('password') ? 'This field is required' : ''"
        />

        <div class="sign-in__row">
          <mod-checkbox label="Remember me" size="small" formControlName="remember" />
          <a mod-link href="/forgot-password">Forgot password?</a>
        </div>

        <button mod-button type="submit" style="width: 100%;" [disabled]="busy()">
          {{ busy() ? 'Signing in...' : 'Sign in' }}
        </button>

        <p class="sign-in__alt">
          Do not have an account?
          <a mod-link href="/sign-up">Create an account</a>
        </p>
      </form>

      <span modAuthFooter>© Organization name 2026 — All rights reserved</span>
    </mod-auth-layout>
  `,
  styles: `
    .sign-in {
      display: grid;
      gap: var(--spacing-2xl);
    }

    .sign-in__row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: var(--spacing-md) var(--spacing-xl);
      font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
    }

    .sign-in__alt {
      margin: 0;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }

    .sign-in__emblem {
      display: block;
      width: 64px;
      height: auto;
      margin-inline: auto;
    }
  `,
})
export class SignIn {
  protected readonly form = new FormGroup({
    userName: new FormControl('', { nonNullable: true, validators: Validators.required }),
    password: new FormControl('', { nonNullable: true, validators: Validators.required }),
    remember: new FormControl(false, { nonNullable: true }),
  });
  protected readonly busy = signal(false);
  protected readonly failed = signal(false);

  protected invalid(name: 'userName' | 'password'): boolean {
    const control = this.form.controls[name];
    return control.invalid && (control.touched || control.dirty);
  }

  protected toggleLanguage(): void {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.dir = root.dir === 'rtl' ? 'ltr' : 'rtl';
  }

  protected async submit(): Promise<void> {
    this.failed.set(false);
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }
    this.busy.set(true);
    try {
      const { userName, password, remember } = this.form.getRawValue();
      // await this.auth.login(userName, password, { remember });
    } catch {
      this.failed.set(true);
      this.form.controls.password.reset('');
    } finally {
      this.busy.set(false);
    }
  }
}
```
